name: iphone-use-wda
description: Initialize WDA in new chats, then control iPhone with guided setup and optimistic actions.

interface.longDescription: For the first iPhone task in a new chat, initialize WDA and establish READY. If the service is stopped, continue guided setup and start the existing build instead of abandoning the task. Reuse a healthy channel for fast optimistic actions and verify key final results.
defaultPrompt: 帮我把 WDA 安装到自己的 iPhone 并验证 READY。
用 WDA 连续完成我的手机任务，并核验最终关键结果。
